intervals.label: Super Charm-Tau factory project at BINP
intervals.locator: SCTF Conceptual Design Report, Part One, title page
intervals.note: Start = the 2018 conceptual design report (a 'very preliminary draft'); earlier tau-charm factory studies at BINP are cited in it (SLAC-Report-451, 1994; a 1995 'C-Tau in Novosibirsk' CDR) but are a different design. In 2020 BINP was still 'developing a Super Charm-Tau factory project' (arXiv:2005.09878). No approval, funding or construction is reported in the sources fetched, and none is dated after 2020; the project status as of 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.
intervals.quote: CONCEPTUAL DESIGN REPORT PART ONE (physics program, detector) [very preliminary draft] Novosibirsk 2018

website.note: The page footer reads 2011-2020; it has not been updated since.
website.quote: Project of Super c-tau Factory BINP Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics

name: Super Charm-Tau Factory (SCTF)
notes: The Atlas marker is the BINP campus: the 2018 CDR places the project 'in the Budker Institute of Nuclear Physics (Novosibirsk, Russia)' without a more precise site, so no tunnel site is recorded.

Parameters differ between documents: the 2018 CDR gives 2 to 5 GeV; the BINP project page also 2 to 5 GeV; a 2020 JINST conference paper (arXiv:2005.09878) says 2 to 7 GeV. The record follows the CDR.

cms_energy.display: 5 GeV (upper end of the 2 to 5 GeV design range)
cms_energy.note: Upper end of the design range; the same sentence gives a peak luminosity of about 10^35 cm^-2 s^-1 (not recorded as a spec because the PDF text prints the exponent as '1035').
cms_energy.quote: An electron-positron collider will operate in the range of center-of-mass energies from 2 to 5 GeV with unprecedented peak luminosity of about 1035 cm−2 c−1 and longitudinally polarized electrons at interaction point.

summary.plain: A proposed electron-positron collider at the Budker Institute in Novosibirsk, Russia, for 2 to 5 GeV collisions with polarised electrons and a luminosity of about 10^35, built to study charm quarks and tau leptons. Only a preliminary 2018 design report exists; no approval or construction is recorded.
summary.technical: SCTF: two-ring e⁺e⁻ collider with crab-waist collisions, full-energy linac and polarised electron injector, √s = 2 to 5 GeV (2 to 7 GeV in a 2020 paper), peak luminosity about 10³⁵ cm⁻² s⁻¹, longitudinally polarised electrons at the interaction point; very preliminary conceptual design report (2 parts) BINP 2018; BINP still described itself as developing the project in 2020. Status after 2020 not found.
